name: claimcheck
title: ClaimCheck: verified accusations vs. counted ones
notes: The same missions on the same seeds with accusations verified against independently re-derived physics (`verified`) and merely counted (`vote_only`). Read `honest_expelled` first: the vote-only configuration starts convicting honest drones as soon as the compromised side becomes the majority, because every mechanism in the consensus layer is an aggregate of opinions and an aggregate follows whichever bloc is larger. `recall` is the honest cost column - past the Byzantine bound the verifier declines to convict on evidence it cannot independently re-derive, so it stops catching attackers rather than guessing at them. `honest_quarantined` is where those refusals went: a reversible hold, not an expulsion.
